```{r}
library(nnls)

estimate_expression_profiles <- function(bulk_expr, cell_fracs) {
  samples <- rownames(bulk_expr)
  genes <- colnames(bulk_expr)
  cell_types <- colnames(cell_fracs)
  
  # Initialize a list of matrices, one per cell type
  expr_by_celltype <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
    matrix(0, nrow = length(samples), ncol = length(genes),
           dimnames = list(samples, genes))
  })
  names(expr_by_celltype) <- cell_types
  
  # Iterate over each sample
  for (s in seq_along(samples)) {
    sample_name <- samples[s] # sample
    p <- cell_fracs[s, ]  # deconvolution in sample
    
    # Iterate over each gene
    for (g in seq_along(genes)) {
      gene_name <- genes[g] # gene
      y <- bulk_expr[s, g] # extract expression per gene and sample
      X <- diag(p) # create a diagonal matrix with the proportions (to give the shape)
      fit <- nnls(X, rep(y, length(p))) # compute non negative linear least squares (avoid negatives) to fit the model. Solve for X*beta = y
      est_expr <- coef(fit) # extract the beta coefficient 
      
      # Store result per cell type
      for (c in seq_along(cell_types)) {
        expr_by_celltype[[c]][s, g] <- est_expr[c]
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(expr_by_celltype)  # one matrix per cell type
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
bulk_expr <- matrix(runif(15), nrow = 3,
                    dimnames = list(paste0("Sample", 1:3), paste0("Gene", 1:5)))
cell_fracs <- matrix(runif(6), nrow = 3,
                     dimnames = list(paste0("Sample", 1:3), c("Tcell", "Myeloid")))
cell_fracs <- cell_fracs / rowSums(cell_fracs)

expr_list <- estimate_expression_profiles(bulk_expr, cell_fracs)

# Access example:
Tcell_expr <- expr_list[["Tcell"]]  # A matrix: samples × genes
head(Tcell_expr)
```
